purpose: Integrate opened-title producer with independently deployed current main without reverting webapp changes
source_preservation: Relative to merged main, the webapp differs only in the17 reviewed opened-demand producer files. All74 independently changed main webapp files are retained.

crate_client_tests.scope: Local HTTP fixture tests only; no live storage

build.command: cd goodwatch-webapp && node node_modules/@remix-run/dev/dist/cli.js vite:build && node scripts/precompress.mjs
build.dependency_handling: Package/lock files identical; existing patched package dependencies linked read-only one package at a time, with Vite temporary cache local to integration worktree. patch-package not repeated on borrowed packages.

backend_scope: Only independently shipped TV Tropes resources enter from main. The schema matches main plus last_opened_at. Latest root-owned detector commit is merged unchanged; this integration performs no Windmill deployment.
deployment_method: Root can fast-forward feat/streaming-refresh to this integration tip, review current main drift again, then integrate into main through the existing main-triggered Coolify deployment. Do not deploy the prior stale feature image or change the Coolify branch. Both page instances must report the resulting SOURCE_COMMIT and healthy readiness. Search roles are separately deployed and are not needed for the page producer.
production_mutations: None by this integration agent; no push, main merge, image deployment or Coolify setting change
